Subject: Exec approval request: combined incentive package for Sapphire Health

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Quick ask — Sapphire Health (potential ARR ~ $420k ARR annualized after conversion) is asking for a combined commercial package to move from pilot to paid. We have a short window to finalize before their board meets next week.

Proposal being requested by the customer (attached):
- Pilot extension to 90 days (they're mid-eval; extension keeps key workflows in test)
- Three months of hosted credits (applies to token usage) — estimated value: $12,000
- First-year commercial discount: 40% off list for year one if they commit to a 12-month contract after pilot

Why approve (short):
- High conversion signal: clinical ops already integrated SDKs; two reference use-cases validated
- Upside: TAM for this account > $400k ARR in 12–18 months (conservative)
- Competitive risk: competitor X is offering steeper short-term credits; losing the account may slow regional momentum

Risks / constraints:
- 40% is outside our standard commercial guideline (we typically cap at 30–35% for deals of this size)
- Need legal to add a time-limited promotional clause and ensure no automatic renewal of promotional pricing

Ask: Can I get approval for the combined package as-is or with a modified discount cap (35%) by EOD today? Attached: SOW draft and pilot cost estimate.

Attachments: Sapphire_SOW_v1.pdf; pilot-cost-estimate.xlsx

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sofia — thanks for the write-up and attachments. I support moving quickly to lock the account but recommend we tighten one item: drop the discount to 35% and require a minimum committed spend of $60k for year one (or structured ramp: 20% Q1, 30% Q2, 35% Q3+).

Also request Neha (CS) to confirm onboarding timeline — we need to ensure the extended pilot doesn't push the go-live past the window where the discount applies. Finally, finance needs to confirm that the credit bucket ($12k) is acceptable under the pilot incentives program.

If finance signs off on the credit cap and legal adds the promotion clause, I can greenlight the 35% + 3 months credits.

-Marissa
